blocks.html: With the Christmas and New Year holidays just around the corner, Robinsons Malls shall be implementing its new operating hours until January 1, 2021.

If you’re planning to drop by for some last-minute gift hunting, the following malls shall open at 10:00 AM and operate until its respective closing hours until Dec. 30 (except Dec. 24-25, 31 & Jan 1): Robinsons Angeles, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Cainta, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Metro East, Robinsons Starmills, Galleria South, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Luisita, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Tagaytay, Robinsons Place Novaliches, Robinsons Place Palawan and Robinsons Place Naga.

On the other hand, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Place GenTri, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, Robinsons Place Santiago, and Robinsons Place Pangasinan will open at 9:00 AM. For Mondays to Thursdays, Robinsons Magnolia will open at 11:00 AM and Robinsons Place Tuguegarao will open at 9:00 while on Fridays to Sundays, both malls will operate at 10:00 AM. Robinsons Place Novaliches and Robinsons Place Palawan will open at 9:00 AM on Dec. 18-23. While Robinsons Place Naga will open at 9:00 AM on Dec. 23 & 30.

On December 24 & 31, the following malls will open at 9:00 AM: Robinsons Angeles, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Cainta, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Metro East, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Starmills, Robinsons Place Tuguegarao, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Naga, and Robinsons Place Novaliches.

While the following malls will open at 10:00 AM: Galleria South, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Luisita, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, and Robinsons Tagaytay.

For Christmas and New Year’s Day, the following malls will open at 11:00 AM: Robinsons Angeles, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Cainta, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Place GenTri, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, and Robinsons Starmills. While Robinsons Place Metro East will open at 10:00 AM on Dec. 25 and Forum Robinsons will be open at 12:00 NN for both Christmas and New Year’s Day.

Lasty, start the year 2021 in Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Metro East, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Place Tuguegarao, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Place Naga, Robinsons Place Novaliches, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Place Palawan, and Robinsons Sta. Rosa as they open at 12:00 NN. While Galleria South, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, and Robinsons Luisita will open at 10:00 AM.
To view other announcements of Robinsons Malls just visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like RobinsonsMalls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram; and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter.
